Every investigation leaves behind questions, but what are the final findings when the Ghost Adventures crew enters some of the world's most haunted locations? Across the Ghost Adventures TV Series, the Ghost Hunters take on intense paranormal investigation sessions, exploring haunted houses, scary places and locations known for chilling hauntings. From ghost sightings and unexplained paranormal activity to possible ghost evidence, these paranormal investigators examine every lead.
Watch Ghost Adventures, S4, Episodes 2, 6,13, 5 & 1 and S3, Episodes 2, 5 & 1 on Discovery Channel India.
